doc: The attract demo under the rule, for the checks that read the owner's real-time captures until 2026-10-22 (docs/ROADMAP.md 1.1). Each is the power-on cartridge under the rule (CT_ORACLE_LOGICAL), the history the port's --scene 433 vehicle plays since 404971a (its frame f = the power-on's f + 91, a picture P = --peek boot P + 92). Frames below are counted from power-on: fxa_attract_cena_inicial is power-on + 2159, so a pad 0:N from it stands at power-on + 2159 + N.

fixtures.doc: stands in for saves/attract_cena_inicial.state (the owner's real-time snes9x capture): loc 1B1 fading in at power-on + 2159 under the rule. A --peek of q frames from here is --peek boot of 2159 + q, so the vehicle's port frame p is this state's frame p - 2067.

stands in for saves/attract_race_handoff_rule_f8247.state (saved under an earlier rule): loc 1B1 at power-on + 8164, the state from which the field hands the motorcycle race ($0384 = 60) to C3:0000 at its f19 (ct.exe --xlatentries), the hand-off --racepiccmp's argument 19 names. (The entry-3 twin of saves/attract_entry3_handoff_rule_f8859.state is attract.json's saves/attract_entry3_handoff_f6750.state: power-on + 8776, C3:0000 at its f18.)

stands in for saves/attract_loc0AD_flea.state (the owner's real-time capture at loc 0AD before Flea's entrance): power-on + 3758 under the rule, 50 frames before the port's f3716 (Flea's overlapping entrance pose, identical on this state's f48-f52) -- so this state's f + 3666 is the vehicle's frame on the field

the 087 leg's start under the rule (power-on + 9112, 3 frames before $0100 = 087 -- the Zombor fight's leg): stands in for build/_z_f7085.state, which the Zombor tools (zombor_orbit_cmp.py and its kin) made by running the owner's real-time capture saves/attract_cena_inicial.state to f7085, the same 3 frames before its own 087 load (f7088 there, f6956 from the rule's fxa_attract_cena_inicial)
